text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You want me to do an interview?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yes. According to Tazuna, the reporters
are practically climbing over
the gates for
a chance to talk to you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yes. According to Tazuna, the reporters
are practically climbing over
the gates for
a chance to talk to you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
They must be extra interested now that
you're the favorite to win the
autumn
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So it would seem...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Don't wanna do it? Then
send me instead!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A simple "I'm currently abstaining from my
beloved cakes for my diet."
will convince
them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wait, did you see me pacing in front of
that cake shop earlier?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't remember mandating a diet... It
must be self-imposed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, it's quite all right. If I give in to
temptation once, who knows what
other
excuses I'll make?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I will go and speak to the
reporters.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You're currently the favorite for the
autumn Tenno Sho. How
confident are you
in your ability to take home the win?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very much so. However, one never knows
what may happen during a
race. I wish to
approach the contest free from arrogance.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
There are some very notable competitors
slated to run that day. What
kind of
strategy are you thinking of employing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well, ah...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen glances my way, her
expression seemingly asking if
that is a
topic she should broach.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: I'm afraid that we can't share those details.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Let's just say that it would be great if we
could get a starting position
on the inside.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that at one point, your team
consisted only of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's right, though we have managed to
turn things around as of
late.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Would it be accurate to chalk that up to
your performance at the
spring Tenno
Sho?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen looks my way again. I sense that
she's struggling to come
up with a good
answer to that question.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Even when the team was on the verge of
disbandment, she pulled
through and
attracted new talent with her achievement.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
McQueen's efforts have been a big
inspiration for the others.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
I see. We're expecting big things from you
here on out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh! Yes! Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, do you have anything you'd like to
say to your fans?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored that you would support me to
the point where I am the
favorite to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'll be devoting my all to my training in
preparation for the race. I do
not plan on
letting you down.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, so serious! Couldn't shake up the
typical interview a bit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Again, that's because I am serious.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but all of your answers were sooo
cool!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I really can't wait for the race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the fans who are expecting
great things of Mejiro
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't think of anyone more deserving to
stand at the center of a
team.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right, why don't we go get something
tasty to charge us back up?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wooo, hella! I'm about to go to town on
some all-you-can-eat lobster!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting to try that place with
the famous carrot sweets
lately!

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Geez, this is a celebration for McQueen,
so let's let her pick, all
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Um... I'm afraid I will have to refrain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I should really move on to my training for
today. That interview took
up a lot of
precious time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, you're gonna go out for training
now? You really good on
keeping up this
pace?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I won't push myself too hard.
The last thing I need is a
repeat of the
time I fell ill.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But I'm finally hitting my stride with my
routine. I can't let this chance
go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is it fine with you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Well then, I shall be off.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Super serious, that one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, the day of the autumn Tenno Sho
arrives.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Wow, those stands are absolutely packed.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Wow, those stands are absolutely packed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Meaning that Golshi Yakisoba's on track
for some record profits! I've
got noods to
fry!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
What, and miss cheering for McQueen?
Speaking of, where is she?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
What, and miss cheering for McQueen?
Speaking of, where is she?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: She's already on her way out there, yo.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Really? But there's still so much time left
before the race starts...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Really? But there's still so much time left
before the race starts...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have the dignity of the Mejiro name to
bear... the hopes of countless
fans on my
shoulders...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My dear team members' expectations, and
those of my trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For all of their sakes, I will achieve victory
today.
